row: 澄清湖位於高雄市鳥松區，是高雄第一大湖與水庫，舊稱大埤湖，1963 年改名；有九曲橋、中興塔等「三橋」「八景」。空拍機紅區，禁止飛行。

airspace.zh: 澄清湖是空拍機紅區（禁止飛行）；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Chengcing Lake is a drone no-fly (red) zone. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

title.en: Chengcing Lake: morning mist and sunset

tagline.zh-Hant: 空拍機紅區的擬真畫面：湖面的霧、九曲橋與夕照
tagline.en: Simulated views of a no-fly zone: mist on the water, the Nine-Turn Bridge and the sunset

zh: 高雄鳥松的澄清湖，天還沒亮。
這裡是空拍機紅區，本片是電腦擬真畫面。
en: Chengcing Lake in Niaosong, Kaohsiung, before daybreak.
This is a no-fly zone for drones; the film is simulated.

zh: 澄清湖是高雄最大的湖，也是一座水庫。
有效容量約 263 萬立方公尺，供應高雄的用水。
en: It is Kaohsiung's largest lake, and a reservoir too.
It holds about 2.63 million cubic metres of usable water for the city.

zh: 九曲橋是湖上的「三橋」之一。
「曲橋釣月」，名列澄清湖八景。
en: The Nine-Turn Bridge is one of the "three bridges" on the lake.
"Fishing for the Moon from the Winding Bridge" is one of its eight views.

zh: 太陽出來，晨霧從湖面慢慢散開。
從空中看，湖的輪廓像一頭大象。
en: The sun comes up and the mist lifts slowly off the water.
From the air, the lake is shaped rather like an elephant.

zh: 西岸高處的中興塔，是八景中的「高丘望海」。
晴朗的日子，從這裡可以望向高雄的海。
en: Zhongxing Pagoda, high on the west shore, is the view "Gazing at the Sea from the High Hill".
On clear days you can look out toward the sea at Kaohsiung.

zh: 這裡原是曹公圳灌溉系統的埤塘，舊稱大埤湖。
1963 年，改名為澄清湖。
en: It began as a pond in the Caogong Canal irrigation system, once called Dapi Lake.
In 1963 it was renamed Chengcing Lake.

zh: 湖邊原本還有一座小埤湖，
填平後蓋了長庚醫院與澄清湖棒球場。
en: There was once a smaller lake beside it, Xiaopi Lake;
it was filled in for a hospital and the Chengcing Lake Baseball Stadium.

zh: 1987 年，它和日本秋田縣的田澤湖結為姐妹湖。
2009 年世界運動會，這裡舉辦原野射箭與定向越野。
en: In 1987 it became a sister lake of Lake Tazawa in Akita, Japan.
At the 2009 World Games it hosted field archery and orienteering.

zh: 傍晚，太陽往西岸落下。
2025 年 7 月起由高雄市政府代管，入園免費（汽機車另計）。
en: In the evening the sun goes down beyond the west shore.
Since July 2025 the city has run the scenic area; entry is free (vehicles pay).

zh: 夕陽落向西岸的樹林，湖面拉出一條金色的光。
依當天的日照計算，太陽在西南偏西落下。
en: The sun sets over the trees on the west shore and draws a path of gold across the water.
By that day's sun position, it goes down in the west-south-west.

zh: 太陽落下後，湖水轉成深藍。
每年約有百萬人次來到澄清湖。
en: After sunset the water turns deep blue.
About a million visits are made to the lake each year.

zh: 提醒：澄清湖是空拍機紅區，禁止飛行。
本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
en: Remember: Chengcing Lake is a no-fly zone for drones.
This film is simulated, not real drone footage.
